A [[human]] [[gender|female]] worked as a '''lab tech''' on the [[planet]] [[Plazir-15]]'s morgue<ref name="Chapter 22">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 22: Guns for Hire}}</ref> in [[9 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|22}}</ref> During that time, a surge of [[droid]] malfunctions troubled the peaceful city and [[Royal family of Plazir-15|Lord]] [[Bombardier (individual)|Bombardier]] requested the intervention of [[Mandalorian]]s [[Din Djarin]] and [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] who correctly identified the next droid unit to malfunction and managed to destroy it. After bringing it to the morgue, the lab tech helped them collect [[Nepenthé]] from its systems, as they suspected a spiked batch of the drink to be responsible for the malfunctions. The tech confirmed their suspicions by analyzing the sample and discovering that it was laced with [[NM-K reconstitutor|nano-droids]], but before they could act on their find the tech's [[IT-O interrogation droid|IT-O Interrogator]] was infected with the droids due to its brief exposure and attacked them. Djarin used the [[darksaber]] to destroy the unit which was attacking the lab tech and Kryze, and the tech subsequently analyzed the droids and discovered that they had been purchased and used by the security [[commissioner]], [[Helgait]].<ref name="Chapter 22" />
